title: 3D Material Finish Switcher
description: Full-viewport Three.js hero with a GLB pocket watch whose finish is swapped at runtime from a JSON of PBR presets: three MeshPhysicalMaterial recipes plus a real MeshTransmissionMaterial for the crystal, lit by nothing but a generated studio HDRI whose bright panel is aimed at the exact cone a flat case reflects. The dial stays towards the camera — the case sways instead of turning, and a drag eases back — so the highlight travels across the finish in every frame. A static poster is the LCP, the canvas is only built when the section enters the viewport, and a capability gate plus a runtime frame-time ladder decide whether the visitor gets transmission, plain physical, or the still.

images.desc: Vintage pocket watch by Tal Swicegood (Poly Haven, CC0), run through the r3f-lab prepare-model pipeline: textures stripped, meshopt-compressed, 16.098 triangles, 241 KB binary glTF (from 1,90 MB of glTF + bin + three 1k JPEG maps)
images.role: The case whose finish the visitor switches; its glass mesh is the one that takes the transmission material

images.desc: Procedural studio environment, 512x256 Radiance RGBE, 72 KB, generated by scripts/make-studio-hdri.mjs: a softbox array with two mullion gaps behind the camera, two rim strips at the sides, a weak ceiling and an almost black room
images.role: The only light in the scene: image-based lighting and every reflection come from this file. It replaced empty_warehouse_01, which filled the narrow cone a flat watch case reflects with one flat concrete value and made every finish read as matte plastic

images.desc: Four verbatim exports of the r3f-lab material sandbox, one per finish, each carrying the full material numbers mesh by mesh
images.role: The finish definitions the component reads at runtime; no PBR value is written in the JavaScript

images.desc: 1600x1000 still of the default brushed-metal finish, re-rendered from a live frame on 2026-08-16 under the studio HDRI and after the anisotropy fix, 26 KB WebP. It is the LCP: it must always match what the canvas draws, so re-render it whenever the environment, the tilt or the default finish changes.
images.role: The LCP element and the permanent fallback when the capability gate says no

images.desc: Fraunces variable, latin subset, 66 KB WOFF2 (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
images.role: Display face for the wordmark and the headline; self-hosted so the build asks nothing of fonts.gstatic.com

images.desc: Inter variable, latin subset, 47 KB WOFF2 (SIL Open Font License 1.1)
images.role: Text face for the nav, the finish card and the buttons; self-hosted for the same reason

intent.useWhen: Úsalo cuando el producto es UNO y lo que se vende es el acabado: el mismo objeto en cuatro materiales, cambiando al pulsar, con el vidrio refractando de verdad.
